Definition: Direct and value-chain greenhouse-gas emissions and climate impact.
Example metrics to extract: Scope 1; Scope 2; Scope 3; carbon intensity; emissions trend

Definition: Energy demand, fuel mix, electricity sourcing and renewable energy.
Example metrics to extract: Total energy; electricity; fuel; renewable %; energy intensity

Definition: Water withdrawal, consumption, discharge, recycling and water-stress exposure.
Example metrics to extract: Withdrawal; consumption; discharge; stressed-area water; recycled/reused water

Definition: Waste generation, hazardous waste, diversion, recycled inputs and circularity.
Example metrics to extract: Total waste; hazardous waste; landfill; recycled/reused/recovered; recycled input %

Definition: Land, ecosystem, deforestation and nature impacts/dependencies.
Example metrics to extract: Land disturbed/restored; protected-area exposure; deforestation; biodiversity plans

Definition: Air pollutants, chemical releases, spills and environmental incidents.
Example metrics to extract: NOx; SOx; VOC; PM; spills; toxic releases; environmental fines

Definition: Employment quality, turnover, training, compensation, inclusion and labor relations.
Example metrics to extract: Turnover; training; pay; engagement; bargaining coverage; diversity

Definition: Occupational health and safety for employees and contractors.
Example metrics to extract: Fatalities; TRIR; LTIR/LTIFR; occupational disease; days lost

Definition: Human-rights exposure and sustainability performance in the supply chain.
Example metrics to extract: Supplier audits; forced/child labor; traceability; corrective actions

Definition: Product safety, quality, accessibility, marketing and customer outcomes.
Example metrics to extract: Recalls; product incidents; customer safety; complaints; responsible marketing

Definition: Protection of customer, employee and operational data and systems.
Example metrics to extract: Breaches; customers affected; privacy incidents; cyber resilience

Definition: Impacts on communities, affordability, access and social license to operate.
Example metrics to extract: Community investment; grievances; indigenous rights; access/affordability

Definition: Capital allocation and innovation supporting sustainable transition.
Example metrics to extract: Green CapEx; sustainable revenue; clean R&D; renewable capacity; target progress

Definition: Exposure and adaptation to flood, heat, drought, storms, wildfire and sea-level rise.
Example metrics to extract: Assets/revenue exposed; scenario analysis; adaptation plan/investment

Definition: Dependence on scarce resources, critical inputs and supplier concentration.
Example metrics to extract: Critical suppliers/materials; concentration; water/energy dependency; alternatives
